# `stop-bar` params (platformer-lab)

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the `paramsSchema` of mini game `stop-bar` in `games/platformer-lab`'s `miniGames(content)`. Do not edit by hand: `pnpm docs:check` (part of `pnpm test`) fails when this page is out of date. -->

STOP THE BAR: a mini game the game `platformer-lab` defines (`HeadlessEntry.miniGames` in
`games/platformer-lab`), so its id is the game's, not a kit's. Its `params` are written where the game's
content names it; `pnpm cli validate` checks them with the content. See the
[schema reference](../schemas.md#mini-game-params) for the kits' own mini games.

- Named in: games/platformer-lab/content/levels/lab-5-trigger.json (triggers.0.params)

| Field   | Type      | Required | Default | Limits | Description                                              |
| ------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cells` | `integer` | no       |         | >= 1   | cells in the bar (16 when left out; at least 2 are used) |
| `zone`  | `integer` | no       |         | >= 1   | cells in the zone (3; kept shorter than the bar)         |
| `every` | `integer` | no       |         | >= 1   | ticks per marker move (4)                                |
| `ticks` | `integer` | no       |         | >= 1   | the time limit in ticks (240)                            |
